lens: Iwai — simulated musical-toy, discovery and collection-garden lens; not the named creator's opinion
scope: Independent blind source review of candidate 2.3.0-alpha.207, revision c594c021. Read AGENTS.md under the supplied blind-review exception, src/rare-cards.js, src/collection-garden.js, src/journal.js, src/house.js, and supporting garden-model.js/house-audio.js source; read tests/collection_commit_smoke.py and tests/experience_garden_smoke.py as text only. No execution, listening, screenshots, repository edits or delegation.

scoreBasis.visual: Unobserved: /tmp/e7-final-capturas was absent when checked. Source cannot establish the rendered result.
scoreBasis.audio: Perceptual audio unobserved. Technical inspection confirms instrument/technique mapping and gesture/sequence scheduling, but is not listening.
scoreBasis.creativity: Source-defined interaction concept only: a located discovery becomes a retained card, a playable house object and one of four combinable garden voices; three distinct roles plus a saved set can produce a following musical sprout (collection-garden.js:8-10; garden-model.js:13). This is a meaningful reuse of a discovery across play contexts. Surprise, legibility and delight in actual play remain unobserved.
scoreBasis.sensation: Unobserved: no hands-on session or perceptual sound evaluation.
scoreBasis.cohesion: Source-defined discovery-to-book-to-refuge loop: card provenance, musical roles, a direct refuge link, and reusable voices share a common vocabulary and retained ownership (rare-cards.js:81-89,97; journal.js:109-110; collection-garden.js:15-20). Cross-modal timing and perceived unity were not observed.
scoreBasis.polish: Static interaction and persistence scope only: selection, limits, future-version protection and rollback are explicit in the card/set UI, while direct manipulation has a verified rollback gap. Does not grade visual fit, listening quality, browser behavior or test pass status.

strengths.assessment: Discoveries retain their place, provenance and ownership while gaining another use as musical voices. Collection does not itself start audio or open a modal; the book offers an explicit add action and selected/full states. This supports exploration without turning every find into an interruption or expenditure.

The garden has a concrete toy mechanism: cards determine instruments and roles, objects can be moved and triggered, walking brushes nearby voices, and a pulse answers with up to four nearby objects. A multi-role saved combination can create a moving musical sprout. These are source-verified mechanisms, not claims about how enjoyable they feel or sound.

The add/remove/save/load UI explicitly rolls back failed writes and preserves future-version gardens. The supplied smoke script targets failed writes, reload preservation and nonconsumed cards; this review did not execute it.

findings.type: VERIFIED source defect; runtime failure path untested
findings.issue: Direct manipulation bypasses the garden commit rollback. Dragging a garden voice outside the house removes its card ID before an unchecked save; dropping a moved voice likewise changes positions before an unchecked save. These paths do not restore the previous garden when save() returns false, unlike the explicit garden controls.
findings.consequence: After a storage failure the visible composition can change despite not being persisted, and reloading can restore a different composition. The drag-out path can also say 'Objeto guardado.' before learning whether storage succeeded. Discovery ownership itself is retained.
findings.remedy: Route garden movement and drag-out removal through the same snapshot/commit/rollback operation as the explicit garden controls, and report success only after persistence succeeds. Add those two failure paths to collection_commit_smoke.py; its current failure checks cover the controls, not canvas dragging.

limits: Screenshots were unavailable at both checks, so visual is null. No browser, Node tests, audio renders or git mutations were run.

The experience smoke text intercepts houseAudioCue (tests/experience_garden_smoke.py:20-21). That can demonstrate a scheduled technical event when run; it cannot establish audible quality, perceived causality, pleasure or sensation. This reviewer did not run it.
No natural rarity, unforced discovery, human usability, device listening or longitudinal collection behavior was observed. Scripted forced cards in the supplied tests are fixtures.
The approved black space, Geist Mono, small cube, sequential ring unlocking and slow transitions are constraints, not defects. Their rendered execution was not assessed.
